qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Installed base of ophthalmic surgical consoles mandates high-margin closed-system consumables per surgery with steep surgeon switching costs, complemented by annual 3-5% price hikes and premium mix in contact lenses.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Global eye care titan leading ophthalmic surgical equipment/consumables and contact lenses. Moat anchored in massive installed console base driving recurring single-use consumable sales and surgeon workflow lock-in. 16%+ operating ROIC and >100% FCF conversion overcome legacy Novartis spin-off intangibles. [5-10Y g: cataract/contact lens volume 4.5% + AT-IOL/SiHy price-mix 2.0% + operating leverage 1.5% + share buybacks 0.5%]
qualitative.evidence: Global #1 in ophthalmic surgical equipment and #2 in vision care. Operating ROIC of 16-18% comfortably clears hurdles (GAAP ROIC depressed by ~$18B legacy Novartis spin-off PPA intangibles). Multi-year Owner FCF conversion exceeds 100% ($1.45B Owner FCF vs $980M net income in 2025). Net debt of $2.6B is 2.7x net income, and interest coverage is 6.7x EBIT. Demographically insulated from all 5 macrotrends with aging populations driving cataract surgery volumes.
